name: GigaWorld-1 / WMBench
summary: 面向机器人策略评测的世界模型基准，覆盖闭环控制、分布外回放和多源长时数据。
summaryEn: A world-model benchmark for robot-policy evaluation covering closed-loop control, out-of-distribution rollouts, and long-horizon data from multiple sources.
scale: Approximately 12,980 hours, 20,000+ rollouts, 10 world models, and 15 metrics
scaleZh: 约 12,980 小时、20,000+ 条回放、10 个世界模型和 15 项指标
organizationsZh: GigaAI / CVPR 世界模型赛道
license: See official repository and benchmark terms
licenseZh: 见官方仓库和基准条款
access: Official project repository includes closed-loop and OOD rollout artifacts; full data access requires verification
accessZh: 官方仓库包含闭环和 OOD 回放产物，完整数据访问待核验
verdict: 以闭环机器人控制回放系统评测世界模型的专用基准
verdictEn: A dedicated benchmark evaluating world models through closed-loop robot-control rollouts
wmNote: 同时报告多模型、多指标和分布外回放，适合比较预测与控制一致性。
wmNoteEn: Multi-model, multi-metric, and OOD rollouts support comparison of predictive and control consistency.
